description: These owls were recorded around 8:30 at night in the Shawnee National Forest using my trusty Rode NTG-2 on a mic stand. Even though it was a mild night and the insects and frogs should have been vocalizing, they weren't.  It was kind of neat   --  a dead-quiet night with nothing but these owls.  If you thought that owls only do "hoot-hoot" you'll be surprised.  After about a minute into it they really get going.
